action.description: The primary action to perform: extract, list, or test.

silent.description: If true, output only error/warning information in a machine-readable format.

progress_enabled.description: If true, force progress bar output.

progress_disabled.description: If true, never show a progress bar.

lowercase_filenames.description: If true, convert extracted filenames to lower-case.

codepage.description: The Windows codepage number to use for ANSI string encoding. Null to use default guess.

collisions_action.description: How to handle duplicate files: overwrite, rename, rename-all, or error.

default_language.description: Set a specific language as the default for collision resolution.

output_dir.description: The directory to extract files into.

password_file.description: The file path to load the password from.

check_password.description: If true, abort processing if the password is incorrect.

timestamps.description: Timezone for file times. Can be a timezone name, offset, 'local', or 'none'.

gog.description: If true, try to process additional .bin files for GOG.com installers.

no_gog_galaxy.description: If true, don't re-assemble GOG Galaxy file parts.

no_extract_unknown.description: If true, abort if the Inno Setup version is unknown.

exclude_temp.description: If true, don't extract temporary files.

language.description: Extract only files for the specified language.

language_only.description: If true, only extract language-specific files.

include_patterns.description: A list of path patterns to include. Only files matching these patterns will be processed.

dump.description: If true, don't convert Windows paths to UNIX paths or substitute constants.

show_password.description: If true, show password check information.

list_sizes.description: If true, list uncompressed sizes for files.

list_languages.description: If true, list languages supported by the installer.

gog_game_id.description: If true, determine the GOG.com game ID.

no_warn_unused.description: If true, don't warn on unused .bin files.

input_files.description: A list of installer files to process.

items.description: Placeholder for list item schema compliance. Not used directly as a variable in template logic, but defines the structure if 'include_patterns' were objects. Here 'include_patterns' is a list of strings.
